translations.en: A new sign stood before you.
One step ahead of this spot, I shall place a "trial."
Please make full use of it.
Behind the sign lay an indescribably strange magic circle.
It was so obviously dangerous that anyone in their right mind would stay out...
You could see a magic circle emitting an extremely murky aura.
There was a crack in the wall, with something like parchment
wedged inside.
You were able to retrieve the parchment easily.
You obtained a map.
Your item bag seemed to be full.
You returned the parchment to its original place.

The adventurers have been wiped out.

translations.en: A heavy, oppressive atmosphere blanketed the world.
Something that had been sealed away had revived.
Or perhaps its seal was beginning to break...
Had those vague reports reached
the people of this cursed town?
Or could they sense the danger in the air
and feel uneasy?
Whatever the reason, the people feared what was to come,
yet continued their daily lives in dread.
This was the legendary town trapped by a curse.
The curse of the ancient archmage @7rChu Lu Gah@0r
had made it a forgotten town, cut off from the outside world.
But you knew there was a truth
different from the legend of that curse.
After all, you yourself had played a part
in uncovering that truth...
And today, once more,
your work in that role was about to begin.
Hey, hey! Do you know where the new town is?
You don't?
Then @7rTanya@0r will tell you!
I know everything!
You see, you can get to the new town from @6rMachinetohet@0r.
Huh? Where exactly?
U-um, well...
Y-you should look for it yourself!
@7rTanya@0r knows, but I'm not telling!
See you later!
A dull, oppressive sky...
